settings.name: Emely Jacobs
settings.text: Shipped way faster than i thought! box and handheld were in perfect condition. was a breeze to install games and start playing. highly highly recommend to fans of gba games.

settings.name: Meghann Hoppe
settings.text: So good. perfect screen for gba. lightweight. great buttons. and excellent sleep function especially with nextui.

settings.name: Latrisha Grimes
settings.text: Arrived fairly quickly in perfect condition. works really well. make sure to choose ra game instead of game rooms because it seems to run better

settings.name: Elfreda Adams
settings.text: Excellent. lots of custom firmware options to play around with

settings.name: Sherrell Mosciski
settings.text: The device is really cool, takes me back to my younger years. Definitely not better times 🤣 Shipping was fast and the item is in excellent condition. Thanks again!

settings.name: Erin Altenwerth
settings.text: A true gem, it's quite nostalgic to hold it in your hands, the screen is spectacular with tones and brightness that far surpass those of a DS, the performance has no complaints, it's sufficient for what it was designed for, but as soon as you can, replace the micro SD with a more reliable one.

settings.features_text:
5,000+ classic games preloaded, spanning 30+ retro systems from NES and SNES to Game Boy, GBA and PS1
Flip-open clamshell with a magnetic lid: closes to protect the screen, sleeps when shut and wakes when opened
Bright 3.5 inch laminated IPS screen (640x480) with classic D-pad and face buttons
H700 quad-core chip and 1GB RAM for smooth emulation
Add your own games: the library lives on the microSD card, so you can plug it into a computer and drag and drop your own game files into the matching system folder
Second card slot expandable up to 512GB
Built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth for controllers, plus HD TV output
3300mAh battery for up to 8 hours of play
settings.shipping_text: Free tracked shipping on every order to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days and ship directly from our supplier. See our Shipping Policy and Return and Refund Policy for full details.
